a.lede: N-able released hotfixes to address zero-day bugs affecting its N-central remote monitoring and management (RMM) platform, which were publicly disclosed over the weekend and forced it to take vulnerable hosted environments offline. [...]
a.title: N-able releases security hotfixes for zero-day vulnerabilities

b.lede: N-able has taken its hosted N-central environments offline and urged on-premises customers to shut down their servers after a security researcher publicly disclosed more than 30 alleged zero-day vulnerabilities, including exploits that could let attackers take over vulnerable systems. [...]
b.title: N-able takes cloud platform offline after 30+ "zero-days" published
